program = '''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    for r in range(h - 1):
        row = grid[r]
        # Look for a colored segment after a background prefix, followed by
        # an unfilled background suffix, with the same color continuing at
        # the start of the next row.
        bg = max(set(v for line in grid for v in line), key=lambda v: sum(line.count(v) for line in grid))
        c = 0
        while c < w and row[c] == bg:
            c += 1
        if c == 0 or c == w:
            continue
        color = row[c]
        end = c
        while end < w and row[end] == color:
            end += 1
        if end < w and all(v == bg for v in row[end:]):
            if grid[r + 1][0] == color:
                for j in range(end, w):
                    out[r][j] = 1
    return out
'''
